name: clock-skew-and-reconnect
description: 100 people, 1800 s. Events array is in DELIVERY order, not time order. ~8% of events have t skewed 1-20 s early (an accept can precede its request), ~6% are delivered twice, bursts share one timestamp. GAP: the client is disconnected from t=900 to t=1200; events with t in that window are delivered together right after the gap (replay them as one catch-up at t=1200). Use derive.ts helpers: they sort and dedupe.
